Only 22% of remote job listings show their pay. Brand design is no exception.

Looking at 3,940 active remote listings on Loker Dollar, just 853 (22%) disclose a salary or rate. The rest leave you negotiating in the dark.

Two brand-identity roles that do publish rates:
- Stevens: $3,000-$5,000 per fixed project (B2B SaaS logistics)
- Sidekicks Creative Studio: $1,500-$3,000 per fixed project (street-food brand)

Other design-adjacent gigs: WTP Global video edits $800-$1,200 per project; Love Isn't Blind social media editor $1,000-$2,000/month; South Digital operations lead $2,000-$4,000/month.

One nuance: the higher fixed contract isn't always better for cash flow. A $1,500-$3,000 retainer may mean steadier income and room to upsell.

Data: Loker Dollar remote-job listings, queried 2026-10-12.

https://lokerdollar.com/en/blog/remote-brand-designer-salary-trends-2026
